import requests, json, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
UA={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
print("cwd:",os.getcwd())

# ---------- 1. Verify the "secreted" premise directly from UniProt features ----------
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/A8DZ15.json",headers=UA,timeout=60).json()
seq=j["sequence"]["value"]; L=len(seq)
print("A8DZ15 len",L,"PE:",j.get("proteinExistence"))
print("features:")
for f in j.get("features",[]):
    s=f["location"]["start"]["value"]; e=f["location"]["end"]["value"]
    print(f"   {f['type']:22s} {s}-{e}  {f.get('description','')}")
print("subcellular / keywords:",[k["name"] for k in j.get("keywords",[])])
for c in j.get("comments",[]):
    if c["commentType"] in ("SUBCELLULAR LOCATION","SIMILARITY","CAUTION"):
        print("  comment",c["commentType"],json.dumps(c)[:300])

# ---------- 2. Hydropathy: N-terminal signal peptide vs C-terminal tail ----------
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=9; h=np.array([KD[a] for a in seq])
hyd=np.array([h[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1].mean() for i in range(L)])
nt=hyd[:30]; ct=hyd[265:]
print(f"\nN-term 1-30 max hydropathy {nt.max():.2f} at residue {int(nt.argmax())+1}; "
      f"C-term 266-292 max {ct.max():.2f} at residue {266+int(ct.argmax())}")
print("N-term 1-30 seq:",seq[:30]); print("C-term 266-292 seq:",seq[265:])
# count consecutive residues with hydropathy > 1.6
def runs(x,off):
    out=[];c=0
    for i,v in enumerate(x):
        if v>1.6: c+=1
        else:
            if c>=8: out.append((off+i-c+1,off+i))
            c=0
    if c>=8: out.append((off+len(x)-c+1,off+len(x)))
    return out
print("hydrophobic runs >=8 residues (KD window 9, cutoff 1.6):",runs(hyd,1))
